action_items: [USER ACTION only — not code] Enable 'Places API (New)' on the Google Cloud project for REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY so the <gmp-place-autocomplete> element actually returns suggestions. Currently the element renders and accepts typing, but every keystroke returns 403 from places.googleapis.com so no dropdown appears and gmp-select never fires.
critical_code_review_comments: ProviderHub.jsx line 56-66: hash-scroll useEffect uses a 250ms setTimeout to wait for paint. Works reliably in this test (card scrolled to top:-0.5). Alternative: querySelector inside a useLayoutEffect + requestAnimationFrame would be tighter, but 250ms is fine for user perception.

JobDetail.jsx line 74 and MapPage.jsx line 486: both callers now navigate('/provider#payouts'). Consider extracting a shared helper (e.g., lib/stripeGate.js: onboardBankRedirect()) so a future URL change updates one place.

Backend server.py line 869: onboard_hint is now consistent with the frontend routes. If /provider is ever renamed, remember to grep for '/provider?stripe=onboard' in server.py, email_subs.py, stripe_connect.py comment, and robots.txt.

rca of the issue: Both bugs were fixed at their source: (1) URL mismatch — every /provider-hub reference was replaced with /provider in both frontend callsites and backend hint/email/robots. (2) A new useEffect in ProviderHub reacts to location.hash === '#payouts' or ?stripe=onboard by scrolling [data-testid='stripe-connect-card'] into view after a 250ms tick. React-router doesn't unmount ProviderHub when navigating from /provider → /provider#payouts, but the effect still fires because location.hash changes. Verified working.
